resources.string: Tap anywhere on the screen to focus on that point. Tap AF/MF to toggle manual focus.
Tap and drag to scrub through the video\'s frames. Scrubbing is quadratic - the farther you drag the faster it flips through frames. Tap the edges of the screen to manually flip to the next frame.
If a capture is deleted, its associated mark metadata is deleted too. Captures and the mark database are stored privately on this device.
